reason: A DSH Web client plugin that improves the conversation model-selection interface with searchable, grouped, favoritable models and a separate thinking-level control.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 对话提供支持模糊搜索、供应商分组、收藏筛选和思考档位选择的模型选择器。
summaries.en: Enhances the DSH Web conversation model picker with fuzzy search, supplier grouping, favorites filtering, and a separate thinking-level selector.

capabilities: Replaces the DSH Web conversation model selector with a modal interface
Provides fuzzy search, supplier grouping, favorites filtering, keyboard navigation, and thinking-level selection
Persists favorite models in browser localStorage
Synchronizes model selection with the DSH session model directory
